verdict.rationale: Drata's Trust Center features automated monitoring/controls status (via Trust Center Analytics Dashboard, Monitoring Tests API, and continuous control monitoring) and API/connection automation for evidence collection, suggesting control status can update automatically. However, evidence pack lacks explicit documentation that subprocessor lists and document renewals specifically auto-update in the Trust Center rather than requiring manual entry. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automated subprocessor list syncing, automated document/policy renewal tracking tied to Trust Center display, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these three elements (subprocessors, renewals, control status) all update without manual intervention.
